title: Dishes and their country of origin

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

country.match: Match each dish to the country it comes from.
country.odd: Three of these dishes come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

kind.odd: Three of these are {value}s. Which one isn't?
